videos.title: The Midnight Projectionist
videos.description: A small-town projectionist discovers the films he screens after closing are showing tomorrow’s news.

videos.title: Desert Highway Patrol
videos.description: Two state troopers, one long stretch of desert highway, and a stolen armored car that keeps slipping through the heat haze.

videos.title: Lady of the Lighthouse
videos.description: A keeper’s daughter signals ships through a storm — and a secret her father kept for twenty years.

videos.title: Two Tickets to Nowhere
videos.description: A pair of grifters board the wrong train with the right suitcase. Screwball chases ensue.

videos.title: The Brass Detective
videos.description: Rain, cigarettes and a missing trumpet player. Classic poverty-row noir, rescued from a library sale tape.

videos.title: Harbor Lights Serenade
videos.description: A dockside crooner gets one shot at the big time. Songs, sailors and a very patient tugboat.

videos.title: Rodeo Round-Up
videos.description: Singing cowboy action with trick riding, a crooked sheriff and a horse smarter than everybody.

videos.title: Night of the Gravedigger
videos.description: The groundskeeper at Mercy Hill cemetery keeps digging after dark. Nobody asks what he’s burying.

videos.title: The Thing in the Root Cellar
videos.description: Farm folk discover the pumpkins aren’t the only thing growing down there.

videos.title: Fog Over Hollow Creek
videos.description: A drive-in favourite: campers, a lake, and fog that seems to move on its own.

videos.title: Attack of the Atomic Moths
videos.description: Radiation + porch lights = disaster. Some of the finest puppetry ever filmed on a Tuesday.

videos.title: The Ventriloquist’s Basement
videos.description: He swears the dummy does all the talking. The neighbours are starting to believe him.

videos.title: Witch Hazel Lane
videos.description: A new family moves onto a cul-de-sac where every house has the same strange garden.

videos.title: Robot Patrol 2000
videos.description: In the far-off year 2000, a tin-can lawman learns what it means to be human. Mostly by falling down stairs.

videos.title: Rocket Girls from Planet Zed
videos.description: Interplanetary pilots crash-land in a Nevada diner and refuse to leave until they get pie.

videos.title: The Crystal Satellite
videos.description: Mission control picks up a lullaby coming from orbit. The satellite was launched empty.

videos.title: Moonbase Omega
videos.description: Six scientists, one lunar outpost, and a crate nobody remembers packing.

videos.title: Signals from Andromeda
videos.description: A ham radio operator decodes a message from deep space: it’s a recipe.

videos.title: The Time Tunnel Tapes
videos.description: Pilot episode of a public TV series that never got picked up. Tinfoil, theremins and big ideas.

videos.title: Saturday Morning Mix Vol. 1
videos.description: Two hours of cartoons, cereal bumpers and toy ads exactly as they aired. Commercials intact.

videos.title: Saturday Morning Mix Vol. 2
videos.description: More bowl-of-cereal bliss — including the infamous “mystery cartoon” nobody can identify.

videos.title: Inkwell Classics: Silly Shorts
videos.description: Rubber-hose animation from the public domain: dancing skeletons, singing cows and a very angry cloud.

videos.title: The Puppet Theater Hour
videos.description: A local children’s show with felt puppets, a talking moon and a host who clearly needed a nap.

videos.title: Sing-Along Safari
videos.description: Learn your animals, colours and the deeply catchy “Hippo Hop.”

videos.title: Bedtime Stories with Grandpa Gus
videos.description: An armchair, a cardigan and six stories read slowly enough to put anyone to sleep.

videos.title: The Wonderful World of Electricity
videos.description: Sparky the animated plug explains where power comes from and why you shouldn’t lick the toaster.

videos.title: Dental Hygiene and You
videos.description: A classroom film featuring the most dramatic toothbrush you will ever see.

videos.title: Know Your Microwave Oven
videos.description: Owner’s guide tape: from reheating coffee to “microwave meatloaf.” Yes, really.

videos.title: The Metric System Is Coming!
videos.description: A cheerful warning that America will switch to metric any day now.

videos.title: Manners at the Dinner Table
videos.description: Mid-century etiquette with a very judgemental narrator.

videos.title: Exploring the Home Computer
videos.description: Floppy disks, dot-matrix printers and the promise of recipes stored on cassette.

videos.title: Why Do Leaves Change Color?
videos.description: Time-lapse autumn foliage set to a synthesizer score that slaps.

videos.title: Customer Service the Right Way
videos.description: Role-play scenarios from a regional grocery chain. The “Wrong Way” examples are the best part.

videos.title: Forklift Safety: Part One
videos.description: Pallets, hard hats and a narrator who has seen things.

videos.title: Welcome to the Mall: Employee Orientation
videos.description: Food court, fountain, fire exits. A perfect time capsule of the early ’90s mall.

videos.title: Burger Station Crew Training
videos.description: How to work the grill, the fryer and the drive-thru headset, with a rap about cleanliness.

videos.title: Telephone Etiquette for the Modern Office
videos.description: Hold music, transfer buttons and the art of the professional “please hold.”

videos.title: Ladder Safety Is No Accident
videos.description: Every possible way to fall off a ladder, demonstrated by a very brave stuntman.

videos.title: Aerobicize Your Life
videos.description: Leg warmers on, synth bass up. Grapevine to the left!

videos.title: Neon Step Workout
videos.description: Step class at its most fluorescent, filmed in front of a giant laser backdrop.

videos.title: Senior Stretch & Smile
videos.description: Gentle chair exercises led by the most encouraging instructor in history.

videos.title: Low-Impact Living Room Dance
videos.description: No equipment needed — just move the coffee table.

videos.title: Self-Defense for the Whole Family
videos.description: Wrist grabs, loud voices and a demonstration on a very polite mannequin.

videos.title: Morning Yoga with Sunny
videos.description: Sunrise on a beach, slightly warbly tape, wonderfully calming.

videos.title: Channel 38 Late Night Movie Block (Oct ’87)
videos.description: Four hours straight off a UHF station, complete with horror host, local ads and a sign-off.

videos.title: Local News at Ten — Blizzard Coverage
videos.description: Storm-of-the-century team coverage, live shots from overpasses and a weatherman losing it.

videos.title: Public Access: Cooking with Carl
videos.description: Carl makes a casserole. Carl takes calls. Carl’s cat makes an appearance.

videos.title: Midnight Bowling Tournament
videos.description: Regional championship coverage with commentary so calm it’s practically ASMR.

videos.title: Telethon Highlights 1988
videos.description: Phone banks, jugglers and a tote board that only goes up.

videos.title: Overnight Weather Scan with Smooth Jazz
videos.description: Local forecast loop and the smoothest saxophone ever recorded to tape.

videos.title: Christmas Commercial Breaks 1989
videos.description: Every toy, every department store, every jingle from one December of recorded TV.

videos.title: Saturday Morning Toy Ads Vol. 3
videos.description: Action figures, sugar cereals and “batteries not included.”

videos.title: Station IDs & Bumpers Compilation
videos.description: Spinning logos, chrome text and the voice-over guy at his finest.

videos.title: Infomercial Marathon: Kitchen Gadgets
videos.description: It slices! It dices! But wait — there’s more.

videos.title: Back to School Ads 1992
videos.description: Trapper keepers, light-up sneakers and stores that no longer exist.

videos.title: Camping Trip to Lake Winnemac
videos.description: Tents, a canoe incident and an uncle narrating everything.

videos.title: Grandma Ruth’s 80th Birthday
videos.description: Cake, candles and a very loud rendition of “Happy Birthday.” Found at an estate sale.

videos.title: Little League Championship Game
videos.description: Shot from the bleachers. The Hornets were robbed in the fifth.

videos.title: Our Trip to the World’s Fair
videos.description: Pavilions, monorails and a family that refuses to stop waving at the camera.

videos.title: Unlabeled Tape #14
videos.description: No label, no case — just what we found. Watch at your own risk.

videos.title: Wedding Reception — Do Not Tape Over
videos.description: Somebody did tape over the last 10 minutes. With a cooking show.

videos.title: High School Battle of the Bands ’91
videos.description: Six bands, one gym, a lot of hairspray. The drummer from “Static Shock” rules.

videos.title: Polka Party Live!
videos.description: Accordions to the max, broadcast from a VFW hall.

videos.title: Community Orchestra Summer Pops
videos.description: Outdoor concert under the stars, interrupted only once by a very confused goose.

videos.title: Garage Rock Basement Sessions
videos.description: Fuzz pedals and a single microphone hanging from a ceiling pipe.

videos.title: Church Choir Christmas Cantata
videos.description: Candlelight, robes and a soloist who absolutely nails it.

videos.title: Yule Log Fireplace (Two Hours)
videos.description: Crackling logs and soft carols, taped off a local station on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: Halloween Spook House Walkthrough
videos.description: A neighbourhood haunted garage, filmed with a flashlight taped to the camcorder.

videos.title: Fourth of July Fireworks Downtown
videos.description: The grand finale is worth the wait. Mostly.

videos.title: Thanksgiving Parade (Local Broadcast)
videos.description: Marching bands, giant balloons and two anchors filling a lot of time.

videos.title: A Very Snowy Christmas Special
videos.description: Variety-show holiday special with skits, songs and a suspicious amount of fake snow.
